verdict.rationale: Microsoft's Copilot transparency note states that Copilot centers its responses on high-ranking web content and provides hyperlinked citations after generated text, and in voice-mode transcripts (copilot-docs-28). Researcher is also positioned for finding and synthesizing information (copilot-docs-5). The community evidence does not address web-grounded answers or citations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy, and explicit documentation of result freshness or recency beyond a single transparency-note sentence.
